components.name: Button: default
components.description: Shared default action with a 44px minimum hit area.
components.css: .ds-button-default { min-height:44px; min-width:44px; padding:12px 24px; background:transparent; color:var(--foreground); border:1px solid var(--foreground); border-radius:9999px; font:400 12px/1.4 "JetBrains Mono",monospace; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.14em; transition:background 150ms; } .ds-button-default:hover { background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent); } .ds-button-default:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-button-default:active { background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--foreground) 20%, transparent); } .ds-button-default:disabled { opacity:0.4; }

components.name: Button: outline
components.description: Shared outline action with a 44px minimum hit area.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { min-height:44px; min-width:44px; padding:12px 24px; background:transparent; color:var(--foreground); border:1px solid var(--input); border-radius:9999px; font:400 12px/1.4 "JetBrains Mono",monospace; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.14em; transition:background 150ms; } .ds-button-outline:hover { border-color:var(--foreground); background:var(--accent); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-button-outline:active { background:var(--secondary); } .ds-button-outline:disabled { opacity:0.4; }

narrative.overview:
An editorial gallery on a black canvas frames Vicent's original tattoo photography. The interface recedes: generous space, crisp rectangular imagery, and quiet outlined controls keep attention on the work. The original logo and contact channels carry the artist's identity.

The approved direction adapts the supplied monochrome editorial reference to this portfolio. It does not carry automotive names, proprietary typefaces, vehicle content, or reference-site claims into the product. The page's Experience mode and contact journey are recorded in the surface brief.
keyCharacteristics: Black surfaces with white headings and readable gray body copy.
Flat surfaces, restrained borders, and purposeful motion.
dos: Do preserve the original artwork, logo, contact channels, and truthful English content.
Do let photography carry color and visual emphasis.
Do keep all three typography roles at regular weight.
Do use visible focus, adequate contrast, and 44px control targets.
Do preserve every retained design version and the public contact journey.
Do honor reduced motion and preserve usable content when animation is disabled.
donts: Don't add invented booking, availability, prices, reviews, or credentials.
Don't introduce automotive content or proprietary reference-site assets.
Don't round artwork or add card shadows, gradients, or decorative glows.
Don't use a faint decorative divider as the only visible control boundary.
Don't add a second autoplay controller or replace accessible primitives with custom lookalikes.

rules.name: The Quiet Border Rule
rules.body: The hairline border is decorative separation. Interactive boundaries use the stronger control-border token or white; do not rely on the decorative hairline to identify a control.

rules.name: The Three Roles Rule
rules.body: Use family, scale, spacing, and case for hierarchy. Do not simulate bold or italic weights that are not shipped.
